body.travellerReport: Hi — stuck at Narita. My LAX flight kept getting delayed and I landed too late for the Zipair connection to Singapore tonight. The airline desk put me on a Scoot flight tomorrow morning around 08:20 that gets in mid-afternoon. I am supposed to be at the hackathon lab in the morning and I present at the finals tomorrow afternoon. My bag is tagged for the morning flight. What do we do — is there anything tonight, or do I need a hotel here?
